title: pasania polystachya
intro: Pasania polystachya, commonly known as Himalayan Pasania, is a tree species belonging to the family Meliaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its use in treating various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The plant's therapeutic actions include antioxidant, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, making it a potential treatment for infections and oxidative stress. Pasania polystachya contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may contribute to its potential in treating various diseases.
